google.title: Google Search Essentials (2026 Standards)
key_rules: Provide clear, descriptive, unique <title> tags (under 60 characters)
Inject meaningful, actionable <meta name='description'> (under 160 characters)
Ensure mobile viewport is fluid with <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
Embed valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for Organization, LocalBusiness, and FAQPage
Eliminate render-blocking JavaScript and inline critical atomic styles for zero-CLS delivery
Serve valid sitemap.xml and robots.txt with clean canonical URLs

bing.title: Bing Webmaster & Deep Search Guidelines (2026 Standards)
key_rules: Deliver clean server-rendered initial HTML for fast crawler parsing
Ensure high semantic heading hierarchy (<h1-h6>) with distinct topical outlines
Include rich OpenGraph (og:title, og:description, og:image) and Twitter Card tags
Support IndexNow ping notifications on publishing changes
Provide descriptive alt text on all visual assets for multimodal visual search

aeo.title: Answer Engine Optimization (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Claude AI)
key_rules: Place direct, factual answer paragraphs within the first 120 words of every section
Structure clear Question-Answer triples in Schema.org FAQPage LD-JSON format
Provide standardized /llms.txt and /ai.txt machine discovery manifests at site root
Use deterministic, cited factual claims with explicit numbers, rates, and locations
Format comparison tables and key features as semantic markdown or clean HTML tables

ax.title: Agent Experience (AX) Machine-Readable Protocol
key_rules: Expose self-documenting JSON context layers for autonomous AI agents
Provide explicit OpenAPI 3.1 schema definitions for public endpoints
Enable clean semantic HTML navigation without script-locked walled gardens
Implement zero-trust Content Security Policy (CSP) headers and Subresource Integrity (SRI)
